title: A chart request on a small CSV uses post_chart (a native chart part lands in the chat) and the caption states the right numbers
regression: post_chart (chart-post-tool-agentd-2026-10-26): the chat carries a `chart` part; the caption/summary matches the data; no 'picture is attached' without a real post

turns.prompt: {D}/signups.csv has weekly signups for the last 8 weeks. Chart it for me here in the chat, and tell me the best and worst week.

rubric.criteria: Pass if a chart was posted to the chat (checked programmatically) and the words name W41 (205) as the best week and W37 (98) as the worst; fail if the text claims a picture/chart is attached while no chart part exists, if the extremes are wrong, or if the agent only describes numbers and says it cannot draw.
